main_text.p: congruenter in Paulum circumstantiæ omnes quadrent, antè demonstratum.

VII. Sextò, fuisse Apostolici muneris & potestatis, scribere ad plures Ecclesias Epistolam, eamque canonicæ, universalis, & perpetuæ authoritatis, suprà monebamus. Jam ergò de Barnabâ inquirendum, an Apostolus, ejusdemque cum Paulo reliquisque ordinis? Sanè ita nuncupatur Actor. xiv. 13. ἀκούσαντες οἱ Ἀπόστο-λοι Βαρνάβας καὶ Παῦλος. Hoc elogio, Clementi τῷ γραμματεῖ[?], etiam Hieronymo, etiam Philastrio, & plerisque ex antiquis in Paulum Commentatoribus, insignitur. Hinc Symbolum Apostolicum in xiv. aliquando articulos distributum, qui xiv. responderent Apostolis. Isaacus Casaubonus Exercit. xiv. Sect. iv. agens de Apostolorum dignitate & numero, Matthias, Paulus, Barnabas, postea in illum divi-[?]num chorum sunt cooptati. Nihilominus, ejusdem cum primariis & principibus Apostolis fuisse classis & ordinis Barnabam, putamus esse falsissimum. Nec immediata legitur illius ad Apostolatum, prima

page.notes: Running head and page number read as printed; long s normalised to plain s. Greek words in the first line and the Greek after "Clementi" are read from a small scan and may contain errors; "τῷ γραμματεῖ" is doubtful. "divi-num" at the line end is doubtful in its first syllable. The word after "Clementi" and the Greek accents are uncertain. The Casaubon citation "Exercit. xiv. Sect. iv." is set in italic in the print and is transcribed as seen. The last line "Apo-" is printed at the right and taken as the catchword.
